ctx_u_perp.description: Scandes barrier-normal wind component (m/s). U_perp explicitly represents wind relative to the physically defined Scandes barrier orientation (290 deg inflow axis), providing a compact and physically interpretable barrier-normal flow coordinate.
ctx_u_perp.causal_source: MEPS 700 hPa u and v wind components at valid time t0+h

ctx_mountain_froude.description: Non-dimensional mountain Froude number. Physically motivated flow-regime indicator whose usefulness must be empirically tested for Nuolja.

parameters.N: Virtual-temperature-corrected Brunt-Vaisala frequency (s^-1) calculated hydrostatically over P_sfc -> 700 hPa layer
parameters.h_description: Audited Scandes/Nuolja effective mountain relief (Nuolja summit 1169m - Tornetrask valley 341m)

ctx_mountain_froude.causal_source: MEPS 2m/surface and 700 hPa pressure, temperature, and specific humidity at valid time t0+h

validation_protocol.split_rule: Deterministic 5-fold split on sorted EVEN origins

pre_run_checks: 4. All feature timestamps causal (available at or before t0=00:00 UTC)
5. N calculation verified (P_sfc -> 700 hPa layer with virtual temp correction)
6. h calculation verified (828 m effective relief)
10. Control reproduces the known EVEN baseline (37.6201 W/m2)

acceptance_gates.G2_Fold_Consistency: At least 4 of 5 forward-chaining folds improve (improving_folds >= 4)
acceptance_gates.G4_nMAE_RMSE_NonDegradation: Candidate nMAE <= Control nMAE AND Candidate RMSE <= Control RMSE
acceptance_gates.G5_Causal_Integrity: 100% causal feature availability for all evaluated forecast tuples

stop_conditions: If ANY EVEN gate fails, STOP immediately. Do NOT evaluate ODD. Route closed on EVEN, candidate frozen. ONLY if ALL gates G1-G6 pass, authorize separate ODD evaluation.
